verdict.rationale: Pendo ships an official JavaScript snippet for web apps and mobile SDKs covering Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin Forms and Xamarin Maui. Backend Track Events, however, are documented only as raw REST API calls, not through official server-side language SDKs. missing for 10: official backend SDKs for major server languages (e.g. Node, Python, Java, Go), first-party documentation of the SDKs' event-sending APIs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms

citations.quote: Install and configure Pendo by inserting a JavaScript code block directly into your application.
Install the Pendo SDK to provide analytics and guides across all of your mobile apps.
Pendo provides public developer APIs for the following frameworks: Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin Forms, Xamarin Maui
